name: module_bridge
title: An authorized stream reaches a module program
summary: yumed authorizes the OPEN and connects to the module's UNIX socket. Packaged systemd units run the module under a separate dynamic user.

nodes.title: Client
nodes.note: Opens a configured byte-stream service without a destination, for example through a local forward or the C ABI.

nodes.title: yumed
nodes.note: Checks the authenticated identity's service grant before handing the stream to its module adapter.

nodes.title: Module bridge
nodes.note: Connects to the configured UNIX socket and writes the version, identity and service header before the stream bytes. It preserves both half-closes.

nodes.title: Module program
nodes.note: The packaged systemd units give the module descriptor 3 and a separate dynamic user, with access to the daemon's credential directories blocked. The program serves streams without linking YUME.
